name: pull-in-stability-ball
title: Pull In: Stability Ball
primer: This exercise uses a ball to isolate and work the lower abdominal muscles.
steps: Get into position as if you were performing a pushup.
Place your feet and shins over a Stability Ball.
Keeping your back straight and supporting your weight on your hands, pull your knees towards your chest, so the ball rolls forward under your ankles.
Crunch your abs and then roll the ball back to the starting position by straightening your legs.
tips: Keep your back straight as you perform this exercise.
